newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet fuel diffs weak, deals close in NYH.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet fuel diffs weak, deals close in NYH.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials were steady in exceedingly light action on Friday, traders said.

In Houston, prompt airline-quality 54-grade material was talked between 1.00 cent and 0.75 cent under June NYMEX, while low sulphur 55-grade was talked at about 0.70 cent under for prompt barrels and at 0.25 cent under for very prompt barrels upline from Houston.
In New York Harbor, 54-grade was talked anywhere from 1.50 to 2.00 cents over June NYMEX.
